notes: 0.18.6 - PR #21 test build (stacked on PRs #17-#20, none merged). Controls anywhere gains Ring layouts: save the pie's current slice set and order under a name, then switch between layouts with one tap. Three presets ship in the box - Everyday (all four slices), Device controls (torch + ring), Launcher (Reach + All apps). Saved layouts live on the phone; removing one never changes the slices you're using. Applying a layout drives both the overlay pie and the Home pie through the same setting. Find it in Settings > Device & setup > Controls anywhere, as a Ring layouts section above Slices. Everything from 0.18.5 rides along, including the Opal orb in the pie hub.
